premises.text: A huge underused private bike stock already exists and can be the world's largest rental fleet if connected
premises.evidence_span: there are over 100 million bikes in the US, and there are over 1 billion in the world. To us, this means the largest bike rental system in the world already exists. We just need to connect it

premises.text: An infrastructure-light, location-independent web marketplace matches excess bike supply with traveler and local rental demand
premises.evidence_span: we've created a web platform where we're taking this excess supply of bicycles and meeting it with the demand

premises.text: Listings average about half of shop rental prices while owners set their own rates
premises.evidence_span: Our average price on SpinLister right now is about $20 a day, about half of existing bike rental shop prices

premises.text: Rentals are insured up to $5,000 with institutional insurance if something goes wrong
premises.evidence_span: We insure bicycles up to $5,000. And we have institutional insurance, as well, should anything go wrong in the process of a rental

premises.text: The marketplace facilitates owner–renter conversation so listers own personalized customer service
premises.evidence_span: What we're doing at SpinLister is we're facilitating a conversation. We're letting real people talk about renting out a bicycle that works best for them

value.text: Let travelers and locals rent bikes conveniently from individual owners to explore
value.evidence_span: we allow individual bike owners to rent out their bikes to travelers and locals looking to explore

causal_links.evidence_span: there's this huge pool of bicycles that are not being capitalized on
taking this excess supply of bicycles and meeting it with the demand
about half of existing bike rental shop prices

notes: Listing UI filters, social-proof widgets, and mobile-app roadmap folded into marketplace premise per §4.1(5). Traction city counts excluded. Audience-choice award excluded. Price amount and insurance kept as commercial trust conditions for the same rental offer; grouped in D3 as jointly revisable commercial terms.
